decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is cheap to maintain, sits close to the core shop-hosting offer, and its demand is still uncertain, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.
The responsive template costs little to keep and supports hosting sales to agencies, though its weak visibility leaves some risk it will be quietly removed.
Premium support fits the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service model, uses existing staff, and earns recurring revenue, so there is little reason to give up the option.
The version management tool builds on the platform, has its own page, and reduces recurring operational work for customers, so it is worth keeping while adoption becomes clear.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business, but GDPR-driven demand in 2018 to 2019 is still unfolding and an online generator is cheap to run, so keeping the option open is justified for now.
